items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued November 22 at 2:32AM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.area: Matagorda Bay; Galveston Bay; Coastal waters from Freeport to Matagorda Ship Channel TX out 20 NM; Coastal waters from High Island to Freeport TX out 20 NM
items.description:
Patchy dense fog is expected to impact portions of the Upper Texas
Coast into the morning hours on Sunday. Localized shutout
conditions have been observed. A Marine Dense Fog advisory will
be warranted if fog can manage to become more widespread. Fog has
remained patchy thus far. But trends will monitored closely.

items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 22 at 8:59AM CST until November 22 at 12:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.area: Galveston Bay; Coastal waters from High Island to Freeport TX out 20 NM
items.description:
* WHAT...Dense fog will reduce visibility to 1 NM or less.

* WHERE...Galveston Bay and Coastal waters from High Island to
Freeport TX out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until noon CST today.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility will make navigation difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Low visibility expected to linger across
the lower ship channel and around the Galveston bay entrance.
items.instruction:
If you must navigate, proceed with caution. Use proper fog
signals. Make sure all running lights are on. Remember to use
your radar and compass.
